summary: 过去 24 小时 AI 新闻按技术、模型、商业、投资、安全与监管聚合。页面优先展示影响力高、来源清晰、并且能解释后续产业意义的信号。

keylines.title: 大模型是今日主轴
keylines.text: 过去 24 小时里，大模型相关内容占比最高，说明媒体报道和社交讨论正在向这一方向集中。

keylines.title: Grok / xAI带动 X 讨论
keylines.text: X 热点更偏实时体验和争议观点，适合用来捕捉模型、产品和安全事件的早期信号。

keylines.title: 基础设施仍是深层变量
keylines.text: 芯片、数据中心、电力和推理成本会持续决定 AI 产品能否从发布会走向规模化商业。

stories.title: California tightens rules on AI data center energy and water use
stories.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has signed seven bills designed to prevent AI data centers from passing utility costs onto residents, as reported earlier by the Los Angeles Times.
stories.analysis: 资本与基础设施信号要和现金流、电力、算力利用率一起看，热度本身不等于可持续商业回报。

stories.title: The man who built Apple’s stores doesn’t buy Silicon Valley’s bet on AI shopping
stories.summary: Apple Store architect Ron Johnson says Apple's secret sauce has always been its people.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于商业化信号，后续重点是它是否进入高频工作流，并形成稳定付费或留存。

stories.title: Meta’s Muse is outpacing ChatGPT’s early mobile launch
stories.summary: Meta’s new AI agent Muse has racked up more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada than ChatGPT did over the same period after its mobile debut, according to new estimates from Appfigures.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于模型与产品能力信号，后续重点是它能否带来开发者迁移、企业采用或明确的成本优势。

stories.title: OpenAI forms math advisory group as its AI resolves more than 100 open problems
stories.summary: The group won't be given leeway to slow down or redirect OpenAI's ongoing mathematical research.
stories.analysis: 高管变动会影响 OpenAI 在 AGI、消费产品和商业化之间的资源分配，短期要看继任安排和关键团队稳定性。

stories.title: Meta’s AI agent has been blocked from using Amazon.com
stories.summary: Amazon has its own cohort of foundation models, along with one of the most popular inference platforms on the internet. As long as they're under no legal obligation to open the doors to Muse, why would they?
stories.analysis: 模型新闻需要结合价格、延迟、上下文、工具调用和真实任务稳定性评估，单一榜单不足以判断产品竞争力。

stories.title: NVIDIA Launches DSX Ready to Qualify Power and Cooling Products for AI Factories
stories.summary: Every AI factory needs power and cooling that fit its computing architecture. As AI infrastructure expands, power, cooling, water, site and grid constraints are shaping what builders can deploy.
stories.analysis: 芯片、模型套件和 Agent 编排框架一起出现时，重点不是单点性能，而是端到端推理成本、部署效率和生态绑定。

stories.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
stories.summary: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.
stories.analysis: 高管变动会影响 OpenAI 在 AGI、消费产品和商业化之间的资源分配，短期要看继任安排和关键团队稳定性。

stories.title: Why Deploying Physical AI at Scale Demands Safety at Every Layer
stories.summary: Physical AI is moving rapidly from research to large-scale deployment. By 2035, ABI Research projects an installed base of 49 million level 3-5 autonomous vehicles (AVs), while Omdia estimates that roughly 60 million industrial...

stories.title: From Enablement to Execution, Egypt’s AI Ecosystem Reaches Production Scale
stories.summary: Today, Egypt’s AI builders gathered in the Grand Egyptian Museum for a reception that highlighted the nation’s rapidly growing AI ecosystem — spanning AI natives, developers, researchers, startups and enterprises — building app...
stories.analysis: 用自家 Agent 完成融资是强营销信号，但真正的验证在于企业客户是否愿意把高价值流程交给同类自动化系统。

stories.title: AI Security Is an Engineering Problem — How to Solve It at Every Layer of the Agent Stack
stories.summary: AI security is an engineering problem. That means defined security requirements, enforceable controls, named owners and evidence that protections work.
stories.analysis: 版权诉讼的焦点正在从训练原则转向证据、数据集和输出归因，这会直接影响模型公司的合规成本与数据策略。

stories.title: Higgsfield AI ships new video features in a day with GPT-6 Astra
stories.summary: With GPT-6 Astra, Higgsfield AI makes video ad creation easier for small businesses and brings new creative tools to market faster.
stories.analysis: 消费级影像产品正在把生成式 AI 做成低门槛编辑能力，真正考验的是效果稳定性、版权边界和用户是否高频使用。

stories.title: With Tabby, a former accountant is using AI to make accountants obsolete
stories.summary: Tabby is designed to be a real-time bookkeeping interface, handling clients’ paperwork as it gives them up-to-the-minute data on their business’s profit and loss.
stories.analysis: 这条新闻属于技术路线信号，后续重点是可复现性、工程成本和是否能被开源或商业系统快速吸收。

stories.title: Google’s $899 Googlebook is a bet that you’ll buy a new laptop for Gemini
stories.summary: Google’s AI-native Googlebook ties Gemini to the cursor, dictation, widgets, and other parts of the desktop experience.
stories.analysis: 模型新闻需要结合价格、延迟、上下文、工具调用和真实任务稳定性评估，单一榜单不足以判断产品竞争力。

stories.title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
stories.summary: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to improve safety.
stories.analysis: 安全与真实性议题正在从原则讨论进入可执行工具，媒体、平台和企业需要更快识别合成内容与自动化攻击。

xTrends.signal: 模型能力、价格和开发者可用性是主要讨论点，很多帖子直接拿它和 OpenAI、Anthropic 对比。
讨论集中在新模型分层、企业访问节奏、推理质量和产品体验是否有实质提升。
安全研究者和 CISO 圈层关注 AI Agent 是否会把攻击链自动化到新的速度。
投资者讨论长期数据中心租约、电力容量和 AI 基建股是否进入过热区间。
手机厂商把 AI 拉回端侧入口之争，争议点是功能是否真能改变日常使用。
创作者圈层继续测试视频生成、图像模型和工作流自动化，版权与真实性问题伴随升温。

briefings.title: 从热度看真实优先级
briefings.text: 模型发布仍最容易引爆讨论，但企业最终会按稳定性、成本、权限集成和数据安全来选择供应商。

briefings.title: 安全窗口继续缩短
briefings.text: AI Agent 让攻击链更自动化，防守重点需要前移到身份、权限、工具调用和数据访问异常。

briefings.title: 资本开支影响模型竞争
briefings.text: 算力合同、芯片供应和数据中心成本正在成为 AI 公司竞争力的一部分。

watchlist: OpenAI、Google、NVIDIA 是否发布新的 API、价格或企业访问策略
X 高热讨论是否被主流媒体确认，还是停留在圈层争议
AI 数据中心和芯片供应是否出现新的融资、电力或交付约束
监管机构是否把 AI 安全、版权、金融建议或出口限制推进到执法层面
